name: Autonomous Performance Agent
stats: 11.7× faster (11.7 ms → 1.0 ms) · 8/8 eval cases · 200k-row table
content: Autonomous Performance Agent (AI Agents): "Finds your slowest Postgres query and makes it 11.7× faster.". Slow queries hide in plain sight. The agent reads pg_stat_statements, rebuilds the real query behind Postgres's anonymised version, and tests a fix before and after. If a change hurts performance, it undoes it on its own. Key highlights: **Works on real-world queries:** safely reconstructs parameterised queries instead of skipping most of them. **Knows what not to build:** leaves join reordering to Postgres's own planner, which already does it better. Honest limitation/tradeoff: The 11.7× figure was measured in August 2026 on a Docker Postgres. Next: re-measure it. Verified metrics: 11.7× faster (11.7 ms → 1.0 ms) · 8/8 eval cases · 200k-row table.
